title: The F-Rank Tea Seller - Episode 1: Hunter's Chai (movie version)
format: 16:9, keyframes 1280x720, animated at 1280x720 (Wan 2.2 image-to-video, 720p), upscaled to 1920x1080, 24 fps
style: photorealistic cinematic live action, like a big-budget superhero movie: real people with real skin and hair, anamorphic widescreen look, shallow depth of field, practical lantern and portal light, VFX for aura, magic and monsters, warm/teal colour grade; no cartoon, no comic text on screen (sounds only)
faces: every face is an invented AI person with one locked face reference per character; never a real actor or real person; Viktor must not look like any film hero (short slicked-back hair, black cape, modern silver plate armor)
rules: a character's keyframe is made with their face file as image 0 and 'the same person, with exactly the same face'
write ages as 'a young man of 18' (never 'boy'); state clean-shaven when needed
stills show calm moments; violence and impacts come from the motion step (the safety filter refuses violent stills)
Mumbai streets: name Indian details (marigold strings, oil lamps, Indian shop fronts with plain boards), never just 'lanterns'
signs: keep backgrounds dark or blurred so no fake letters can be read; frame tighter if needed
Raghu's shield is a separate tall rectangular steel tower shield held by a handle on his left arm
a correction of a picture is only for small changes; age and big changes need a fresh picture
every street shot in scenes 3-5 is EVENING after sunset (dark blue sky, lamps lit); scenes 10-12 are NIGHT (black sky)
no glowing mushrooms except in the Level 9 entrance cave (scene 7)
say how many people are in the frame ('exactly three people', 'Arjun alone'), or the model adds strangers and doubles
creatures use a reference picture too: cast/ogre.jpg, cast/minotaur.jpg

cast.arjun: 18, dark brown skin, short messy black hair, brown eyes, slim, white kurta with rolled sleeves, red sash, red string bracelet
cast.viktor: late 20s, tall, broad shoulders, slicked-back blonde hair, blue eyes, silver armor, black cape, longsword
cast.meera: early 20s, brown skin, long black single braid, white robe with gold trim, wooden healer staff
cast.raghu: 30s, huge, bald, thick black beard, heavy armor, tower shield (name to confirm)

shots.motion: torchlight flickers, his chest rises and falls, golden light starts to glow on his armor, slow push in

shots.see: extreme close-up of Viktor's face from the eyebrows to the chin, his eyes glowing bright golden yellow with light, golden light reflecting on his skin, dark background
shots.motion: his eyes ignite bright yellow, light flares and fills the screen to white
line: This power... where is it coming from?!

shots.see: title card over swirling blue Gate light: THE F-RANK TEA SELLER, Episode 1: Hunter's Chai
shots.motion: made in the edit

shots.see: black screen: ONE HOUR EARLIER
shots.motion: made in the edit

shots.see: high aerial view of Marine Drive in Mumbai at dusk, the curved seafront lights like a necklace, a giant ring of blue light turning in the sky over the bay
shots.motion: slow aerial glide along the curve, the ring of light slowly turns, clouds spiral into it
line: Mumbai, 2031. Gates to monster dungeons have opened in every city on Earth.

shots.see: street level in Mumbai: human hunters, ordinary Indian and foreign men and women in modern armor, walk out of a smaller glowing blue Gate carrying glowing blue crystals the size of footballs, a cheering crowd of Indian people films them on phones, no signs or writing anywhere
shots.motion: hunters walk toward camera, the crystals pulse, phones held up, camera tracks back
line: Hunters go in. Monster cores come out. Hunters get rich.

shots.see: Gate Plaza at evening from above: a tall stone arch filled with swirling blue light, a queue of armored hunters, police barriers, food carts, marigold strings and oil lamps, a tiny wooden tea stall with brass pots at the edge
shots.motion: camera floats down from high above toward the tiny tea stall, crowd moves, lamps flicker
line: And right next to the biggest Gate in the city... stands a tiny tea stall.

shots.see: close-up of Arjun's hands crushing green cardamom pods in a small stone mortar on the stall counter, a pot of milk tea boiling behind
shots.motion: the pestle crushes the pods, for a moment a faint golden shimmer rises from the seeds and fades, he tips them into the boiling tea

shots.see: Arjun at his stall pours chai from a steel kettle held high into a small glass held low, a long stream of tea, steam, lamp light
shots.motion: the stream of tea falls from the kettle into the glass, steam rises, he calls out with a smile
line: Chai! Hot chai! Ten rupees a glass!

shots.see: hunters in armor walking past the tea stall without looking, one kicks a paper cup along the ground
shots.motion: they walk past, the paper cup tumbles across the stones

shots.see: Arjun behind his counter holding a full glass, embarrassed small smile, no customers
shots.motion: he looks at the glass, scratches the back of his head, small sigh
line: Business is... a little slow today.

shots.see: a laminated hunter licence card hanging on a nail on the stall post, Arjun's face photo on it, the lamp behind
shots.motion: slow push in to the card, then freeze; a clean card graphic appears: ARJUN / 18 / HUNTER RANK: F
line: Arjun. Eighteen years old. Hunter rank: F, the weakest rank there is.

shots.see: the crowd parts as Viktor, Meera and Raghu walk through the plaza, phones raised, a small camera drone flies beside Viktor

shots.see: freeze on Viktor smiling into his drone, a clean name card graphic: VIKTOR HALE / B-RANK / 2M FOLLOWERS
shots.motion: made in the edit (freeze frame and card)
line: Viktor Hale. B-Rank. Two million followers. Zero manners.

shots.see: Viktor turns toward the tea stall, laughing, pointing a finger at it, the drone behind his shoulder
shots.motion: he points and laughs, the drone swings round to film the stall

shots.see: freeze on Meera with a clean name card: MEERA / HEALER
